en.title: Daily Action Flow, September 22, 2026
en.description: Eight source-ordered actions connect data, evaluation, deployment and capital evidence.
en.centralJudgment: A complete loop needs evidence at every handoff. Today’s completed editorial package maps open evaluation and proposes a bounded Dark Forest experiment; project work and financial choices retain their own authority and evidence requirements.
en.fieldLine: Eight signals. Explicit conditions. One evaluation constitution.

actions.domain: Frontier Models, Agents and OPC Autonomy
actions.title: Specify the HK language pack
actions.why: Hong Kong payments, Cantonese–English switching and cross-border merchant operations form a defensible local intelligence asset.
steps: Build a 20-task HK OPC Language Pack and test all eight model families under identical authority, recording completion, clarification, cultural errors, cost and Robin-intervention minutes; open-source schemas and scoring, not private merchant data.
Freeze 20 tasks, eight model families, equal permissions and scoring; publish no private merchant data. Actual model testing remains a separate project action.
actions.done: READY; 20-task specification preserved, test outcomes UNKNOWN.

actions.title: Build the Spirit AI comparison
actions.why: CATL and JD matter only if their deployments continually generate diverse tasks, failures and recovery data.
steps: Build the Spirit AI peers matrix around independent paying customers, production robot count, task success/intervention, useful-data cost and unit economics after data-labor costs; retain credible learning deployment / unproven scale.
Record the five requested denominators with source dates and independent customer evidence. Missing production or intervention data remains UNKNOWN.
actions.done: READY; comparison assignment preserved, scale unproven.

actions.title: Watch the breadth of Bitcoin inflows
actions.why: Capital is following attention again, but attention currently concentrates on the crypto asset most easily purchased through conventional accounts.
steps: Classify the regime as BTC-led re-entry; upgrade to industry-wide inflow only if at least two of five-day ETF inflows, stablecoin net issuance and non-BTC breadth expand together.
Collect five-day ETF, stablecoin issuance and non-BTC breadth evidence; upgrade only when at least two improve together. No trade is executed.
actions.done: WATCHING; joint expansion threshold preserved, no regime upgrade claimed.

actions.title: Trace tokenized-asset transmission
actions.why: Official products reveal what is permitted; communities, pool depth, fees and holder behavior reveal what people have begun to play.
steps: Create a Meme → Tokenized Asset Transmission Watch, beginning with [Long.xyz](http://long.xyz/) $AI/$NVDA and tracking contracts, real depth, top-ten concentration, net flows, fee recipients, bots/incentives and the precise conversion into the stock representation.
Record contracts, actual pool depth, concentration, net flows, fee recipients and conversion rights. Read-only research does not authorize a transaction.
actions.done: READY; watch specification preserved, contract verification pending.

actions.title: Publish the evaluation constitution
actions.why: Robin can define an evaluation constitution that laboratories, researchers and OPCs can reproduce and challenge—not merely publish another ranking.
steps: Publish the open AI evaluation map and a Model Olympics/Dark Forest design proposal. Preserve the full structured assignment in the Daily Briefing.
Check the four-language article, nine primary references, original four-layer diagram, research entry and archived LinkedIn derivative. Experiments and public code releases remain separate.
actions.done: COMPLETE for the editorial package; public delivery is separately verified in the release receipt.

actions.title: Specify the nuclear uprate comparison
actions.why: The career-value layer is moving upward from facility construction into power subscriptions, cost isolation, project finance and matching contracts with long-duration capital.
steps: Add a nuclear uprate subscription template to the AI Power Portfolio Simulator, comparing capital per MW, offtake duration, regulatory/construction risk and pension-compatible cash-flow layers against gas, SMRs and data-center SPVs; treat the 96 MW as unfinanced until approval.
Compare MW capital, offtake term, regulatory and construction risk, and capital layers. PSC approval and financing evidence remain separate; no simulator modification is claimed.
actions.done: READY; comparison specification preserved, contract and financing details UNKNOWN.

actions.domain: Late-Stage Private Markets × AI Life Sciences
actions.title: Wait for Anew’s biological evidence
actions.why: The investable asset is an auditable loop from computation through wet-lab replication, IND, human safety and patient benefit—not an attractive molecular rendering.
steps: WATCH; do not chase the round. Upgrade to INVESTIGATE only after disclosure of diseases and targets, wet-lab hit rates, an IND or human trial, time/cost advantage, related-party governance and preference terms; plausible exits are IPO, pharmaceutical licensing or strategic acquisition.
Require diseases/targets, wet-lab hit rates, IND or human study, comparative cost/time and governance/preference terms before INVESTIGATE. No allocation request.
actions.done: WATCHING; evidence threshold preserved, no investment action.

actions.title: Watch AMD’s systems disclosures
actions.why: AMD may become the most important AI systems alternative to Nvidia, yet attention and scarcity can reach the valuation destination before cash flow does.
steps: Do not chase the breakout; retain existing exposure and require AMD to quantify rack-scale AI revenue, post-integration gross margin, production ROCm usage and top-three customer concentration before adding.
Require rack AI revenue, integration-adjusted margin, production ROCm use and top-three concentration before reconsidering additions. Preserve the source’s no-chase instruction; no trade.
actions.done: WATCHING; disclosure threshold preserved, no position change.

zh-Hans.title: 每日行动流，2026年9月22日
zh-Hans.description: 八项来源有序行动，连接数据、评测、部署与资本证据。
zh-Hans.centralJudgment: 完整闭环的每次交接都要有证据。今天完成开放评测版图及有边界的Dark Forest实验方案；项目工作与金融判断保留各自授权和证据条件。
zh-Hans.fieldLine: 八个信号。明确条件。一部评测宪法。

actions.title: 定义香港语言题包
actions.why: 香港支付、粤语—英语切换和跨境商户语境，是大模型通用Benchmark难以覆盖、但Robin可以合法积累的“社区智能资产”。
steps: 建立一个20题的HK OPC Language Pack，用相同工具权限测试上述八个模型家族，记录完成率、错误澄清、文化误判、成本及Robin介入分钟；开源题型与评分规则，不公开私人商户数据。
冻结20题、八个模型家族、相同权限与评分；不公开私人商户数据。实际模型测试仍属独立项目行动。
actions.done: READY；已保存20题规格，结果UNKNOWN。

actions.title: 建立Spirit AI比较表
actions.why: CATL与京东最重要的价值不是品牌背书，而是能否持续产生不同任务、异常和失败恢复数据；这才可能形成Physical-AI的数据飞轮。
steps: 建立Spirit AI peers matrix，只按五项重排：独立付费客户、生产环境机器人数量、单任务成功率与干预率、每小时有效数据成本、扣除数据采集人员后的单位经济；暂将Spirit评为credible learning deployment / unproven scale。
记录五项分母、来源日期及独立客户证据；缺失的生产数量和介入数据保留UNKNOWN。
actions.done: READY；已保存比较任务，规模未证实。

actions.title: 观察Bitcoin流入广度
actions.why: “Capital follows attention”重新启动了，但注意力现在集中在最容易被传统账户购买的BTC，而不是均匀流入整个Token经济。
steps: 将市场状态标为BTC-led re-entry；只有连续五个交易日ETF净流入、稳定币净发行与非BTC市场宽度三者至少两项同步改善，才升级为industry-wide inflow。
收集五日ETF、稳定币发行及非BTC广度证据；至少两项同步改善才升级，未执行交易。
actions.done: WATCHING；已保存同步改善门槛，未升级市场状态。

actions.title: 追踪Token化资产传导
actions.why: 机构产品只告诉我们什么被允许交易；社区、池深、费用和持有人变化才告诉我们人群正在玩什么。等待券商研究报告出现，第一轮往往已经结束。
steps: 建立一个Meme → Tokenized Asset Transmission Watch，[首先跟踪Long.xyz](http://long.xyz/) $AI/$NVDA：合约、真实池深、前十持有人集中度、净流入而非成交量、费用去向、激励与机器人比例，以及Token转成股票映射的精确路径。
记录合约、真实池深、集中度、净流入、费用接收方及转换权利；只读研究不授权交易。
actions.done: READY；已保存监测规格，合约待核查。

actions.title: 发布开放评测宪法
actions.why: 这比公布一张“谁最聪明”的榜单更有原创性：Robin可以定义一套让模型公司、独立研究者和OPC共同挑战、复现并改进裁判的制度。
steps: 发布开放AI评测版图及Model Olympics／Dark Forest设计方案；完整结构化任务保留于每日简报。
检查四语文章、九个一手来源、原创四层图、研究记录及归档LinkedIn稿。实验与代码发布另行计证。
actions.done: 编辑包COMPLETE；公开交付另由发布回执核实。

actions.title: 定义核电扩容比较
actions.why: 职业机会正从“建设数据中心”上移到设计电力订阅、监管成本隔离、项目融资和长期资本匹配——非常接近Robin的资本配置优势。
steps: 在AI Power Portfolio Simulator加入nuclear uprate subscription模板，与新建燃气、SMR和数据中心SPV比较每MW资本、承购期限、监管风险、建设风险及养老金可接受的现金流层级；在PSC批准前不把96MW计入已融资容量。
比较每MW资本、承购期限、监管和建设风险、资本层级。PSC批准与融资证据分别记录；未声称修改模拟器。
actions.done: READY；已保存比较规格，合同与融资细节UNKNOWN。

actions.domain: 后期一级市场 × AI生命科学
actions.title: 等待Anew生物学证据
actions.why: 真正可投资的AI生物学资产不是漂亮的分子图，而是计算预测 → 湿实验复现 → IND → 人体安全性 → 患者获益之间不断缩短且可审计的闭环。
steps: WATCH，不追本轮。 只有Anew披露具体疾病/靶点、湿实验命中率、至少一项IND或人体试验、相对传统发现流程的时间成本优势，以及ByteDance关联交易与优先权结构后，才升级为INVESTIGATE；可行退出为IPO、药企授权或战略收购。
要求疾病/靶点、湿实验命中率、IND或人体试验、相对时间成本及治理优先权条款，再转INVESTIGATE；未申请份额。
actions.done: WATCHING；已保存证据门槛，无投资操作。

actions.title: 观察AMD系统业务披露
actions.why: AMD既可能成为NVIDIA之外最重要的AI系统平台，也可能因注意力和稀缺性先达到估值终点；需要区分生态选择权与已经兑现的现金流。
steps: 不追当日突破；维持现有暴露，并把下一次增持门槛固定为AMD同时量化机架级AI收入、扣除系统整合后的毛利、ROCm生产使用量及前三大客户集中度。
要求机架AI收入、整合后毛利、ROCm生产使用和前三客户集中度，再考虑增持。保留来源不追涨方针，未交易。
actions.done: WATCHING；已保存披露门槛，未改变仓位。
